verdict.rationale: Lago's docs describe a self-hosted version deployable with Docker, and the GitHub repo can start a local Lago instance from a checkout. Community comments confirm the self-hosted option, its AGPL licensing, and that it runs on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on production self-hosted deployment (configuration, scaling, upgrades), and clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and cloud.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Docker is the easiest way to get started with the self-hosted version of Lago.
It starts the Lago version that matches this checkout, creates a disposable local organization
a self-hosted option fits our culture and philosophy a lot better
